entities.name: Kopala
entities.description: The youngest of the nine River Herald Shapers, who speaks for the river Kopala and sides with Tishana against Kumena.

entities.name: Tishana
entities.description: The eldest River Herald Shaper and Kopala's mentor, who wants Orazca kept hidden and unused and goes after Kumena.

entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: A powerful, impetuous Shaper and Tishana's former student who wants to wield the Immortal Sun himself and breaks from the others.

entities.name: Sun Empire Soldier
aliases: a soldier of the Sun Empire
entities.description: A captured Sun Empire soldier who reveals pirate and sun champion movements toward the Golden City and is drowned by Kumena.

entities.name: Angrath
aliases: a man with the head of a bull
entities.description: A bull-headed pirate captain, described by the soldier, who seeks the Golden City.

entities.name: Vraska
aliases: a woman with hair like twisting vines
entities.description: A gorgon pirate captain with a compass, described by the soldier, who is said to have discussed her quest openly.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A champion of the sun who performed a spell that revealed the Golden City and who the soldier says will go to its gates.

entities.name: The Last Guardian
entities.description: The being who entrusted the Immortal Sun to the River Heralds to keep hidden and unused.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: The ancient merfolk people of Ixalan, led by nine Shapers, who guard the secret of Orazca.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire of dinosaur riders who seek Orazca and have a visionary guiding them.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: Pirates whose captains seek Orazca with a compass.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: A powerful artifact in Orazca whose misuse once brought ruin to Ixalan.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The Golden City, whose pulse the Shapers feel and whose location the River Heralds have sworn to keep secret.

entities.name: Primal Wellspring
entities.description: A mystical pool in a glade where Kopala and Tishana meditate.

entities.name: The Great River
entities.description: The river system of Ixalan, whose nine tributaries share their names with the Shapers.

entities.name: Deeproot Tree
entities.description: A distant tree whose swaying the Shapers can feel.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane of rivers, jungles and the lost city of Orazca.

events.summary: Kopala meditates in the Primal Wellspring with Tishana and feels the pulse of Orazca skip a beat.
Tishana tells Kopala the disturbance involves Orazca.
events.quote: And what involves Orazca involves the whole world,

events.summary: Kumena arrives at the Wellspring with twenty River Heralds and a captured Sun Empire soldier.
events.quote: A soldier of the Sun Empire, bedraggled but whole, bound with a tangle of vines.

events.summary: The soldier reveals that two pirate captains and a sun champion's vision are converging on Orazca.
events.quote: Forces are converging on your Golden City,

events.summary: Kumena argues that the River Heralds must wield the Immortal Sun themselves, while Tishana insists it must be kept unused.
events.quote: We must wield the power of the Immortal Sun ourselves

events.summary: Tishana says the Last Guardian entrusted them to keep it hidden and unused, and Kumena appeals to Kopala to break the tie.
events.quote: He entrusted us to keep it hidden,

events.summary: Kopala sides with Tishana, saying no one should claim the Golden City, including the Heralds.
events.quote: We must do everything in our power to prevent anyone from claiming the Golden City.

events.summary: Kumena drowns the captive soldier, warns that Tishana's strategy will fail, and rushes off in a wave of water and roots as vessels approach the coast.
events.quote: and then he is gone from the glade

events.summary: Tishana departs to pursue Kumena and tells Kopala to rally the people, admitting the city may not stay hidden.
events.quote: I do not think we can keep the Golden City hidden any longer.

events.summary: Kopala buries the soldier's body beneath the pool to nourish the trees.
events.quote: It is not the end he would have hoped for, but it is the best I can do.

events.summary: Tishana catches up with Kumena on the coast, where he conjures storms against approaching ships, and she overpowers his spell.
events.quote: I subsume his spell with magic of mine own.

events.summary: Tishana rams a ship into a sea stack and exchanges barbs with Kumena before he punches her and knocks her out.
events.quote: I look over my shoulder just in time to see Kumena's fist hit my face.

relations.quote: Tishana, my mentor, is here with me, guiding me
When he was my student, he tested every boundary.

relations.note: breaks from her over wielding the Immortal Sun

relations.quote: The sun warrior is pulled beneath the surface of the Wellspring with a strangled cry.
I am the youngest of the Shapers

relations.note: entrusted the Immortal Sun to them to keep hidden
relations.quote: The Last Guardian entrusted it to us

relations.note: the Heralds guard Orazca, home of the Immortal Sun
relations.quote: We must wield the power of the Immortal Sun ourselves
